description: An oil painting of an older, stocky man in a brown felt hat and a tweed three-piece suit with tie, smiling with both arms raised high, each hand making a V-for-victory sign. Press photographers with flash cameras crowd both sides, a uniformed soldier photographs on the right, microphones on stands, flags and bright lights fill a dim, gritty background. Mid-20th-century dress and equipment, painterly dark palette. No legible letters or numbers, no frame or canvas edge, nothing graphic. A small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner.
